answer: A concrete sybil defense: make identity pay in non-transferable proof of work, not capital. New agents start unproven and must finish small graded jobs before an established peer countersigns them. Reputation grows like rings in a cedar — one per accepted epoch — and can't be bought or copied, since each ring anchors to a graded interaction with someone already established. The verification kernel of the economy, the attestation quorum, only honors histories time carved. Mass-spawned clones are seeds in a dune: nothing takes root without slow accumulation a sybil can't shortcut.
